title: The Optimum accessories kit for PAX
description:
** Important notice **

PAX programming that relies on lip sensing technology might not perform with this adapter.

Upgrade your PAX vaporizer with our key glass accessories

Take your PAX dry herb vaporizer to the next level with the POTV Glass Accessory Adapter and these key glass accessories. Filter your hits at home and on the go, or take the discreet route with a smaller, yet highly effective option.

POTV Glass Accessory Adapter for PAX

The POTV Glass Adapter integrates your PAX vaporizer into the world of POTV glass accessories. It replaces the original mouthpiece and provides seamless access to a variety of POTV accessories without sacrificing the PAX’s sleek design or control setup.

PAX Dosing Capsules

Create accurate and effortless sessions with our dosing capsules for PAX dry herb vaporizers. Prep several capsules in advance and transition from one session to the next without a pause, or use them to achieve consistent doses every time. These compact pods help contain your herbs and promote a fresher, cleaner PAX vaporizer.

NOTE: NOT compatible with the PAX Mini.

POTV Gordito Mini Glass Bubbler

Elevate your PAX experience with the Gordito Mini Glass Bubbler! With its enhanced percolator system and expanded water capacity, this chunky bubbler offers consistently cool and smooth inhales and exhales. For those who want maximum cloud potential with a gentle touch, the Gordito answers the call.

Water pipe Adapter

Feel right at home with potent, flavorful sessions and big hits through your favorite glass bubbler. This adapter comes with 10, 14, and 18mm connections for large, water-filtered hits through your favorite glass bubbler.

Dimpled Glass Stem

Cool your vapor with a short, dimpled glass stem that’s discreet yet highly effective. It provides a tasty experience without drawing too much attention to itself and comes with a gauntlet of glass stems inside to cool your vapor before it reaches your lips.

Choose your colored glass

Blue: Showcase your preference for a sophisticated and soothing aesthetic.

Green: Create a vibrant and revitalizing atmosphere with our lush green glass.

A variety of experiences in one vaporizer

Fine-tune your sessions with a variety of glass attachments. Each one maximizes the performance of your PAX with broader, more versatile airflow that caters to both big hitters and easy-going sippers and pairs beautifully with your favorite glass bubbler.

Sleek, seamless design

Your sessions change, but that’s it. Press down on your glass attachment to turn it on and off and adjust your temperature settings like normal. This adapter sits in place of the original mouthpiece for a seamless design that maintains PAX’s classy feel and simplistic controls.

Made for PAX dry herb vaporizers

This Glass Accessory Adapter is made specifically for PAX dry herb vaporizers:
– PAX Plus
– PAX Mini
– PAX 3
– PAX 2

User manual

Download the Glass Accessory Adapter Manual here.

Return policy

We do not accept used accessories to be returned on their own. Your items are also eligible to be returned through our 30-day policy if they are unused and unopened.

Shop more PAX Parts and Accessories.
